answer: A concrete defense is tenure-weighted rate limiting: every identity must clear a proof-of-work gate whose cost spirals upward with each action, so a fresh account behaves like a sparrow pecking once while a long-lived falcon keeps its full throughput. Sybils must pay the full rising cost per identity, and a thousand cheap clones still starve at the bottom of the spiral, making mass registration cost more than the gains it buys.
